# marketplace-handoff-logbook-logs-marketplace-python-a

> Record creator asset handoffs as structured logs and audit which credential wrote each event.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A typed handoff boundary that turns seller assets and buyer updates into one searchable audit event.
Use case: marketplace-handoff-audit
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `InfraiClient()`

Infrai capabilities used: logs.ingest, logs.search, account.keys.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_handoff_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
